caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical metallic lantern with a dark, possibly black or deep brown, exterior. The lantern has two transparent rectangular panels, one above the other, on the main body, rendered in a pale, greenish-yellow hue suggesting glass or a similar material. Vertical and horizontal metal bands frame these panels, joining at the edges and in the middle. The top of the lantern features a decorative, flared metal collar composed of three ruffled layers, also in the same dark color as the main structure. Above this, there is a large, upright oval-shaped ring, likely serving as a handle or hanging loop, matching the color and texture of the lantern. The lantern is centered on a plain, light beige or off-white background. The artist's signature, "Isidoro A. Hauget," is visible in small, neat text at the bottom right of the composition.
title: Horn Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
